research.facts:
LIV Golf Bankruptcy
**Key verified facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) ending funding after 2026 season
- PIF investment estimated $5-8 billion since 2022
- LIV Golf preparing US bankruptcy filing — could come "as soon as next week" per Newsmax/Semafor reports (late Aug/early Sept)
- Majority of 300+ LIV staff laid off
- Settlement offers sent to players owed guaranteed money — described as "pennies on the dollar" / "a few cents on the dollar"
- Named players with financial exposure: Bryson DeChambeau, Jon Rahm, Cameron Smith
- PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp previously stated no current plan to reinstate LIV golfers
